import Posets.UltrafilterCombinatorics

/-! The proper filter of monochromatic rows and its ultrafilter extension. -/
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable Classical.typeDecidableEq
open Filter
namespace Posets

/-- The filter generated by arbitrarily late rows that are homogeneous for a finite
collection of column subsets. -/
def synchronizedFilter : Filter RowDomain where
  sets := {s | ∃ K F, synchronizedRows K F ⊆ s}
  univ_sets := ⟨0, ∅, Set.subset_univ _⟩
  sets_of_superset := by
    rintro s t ⟨K, F, hs⟩ hst
    exact ⟨K, F, hs.trans hst⟩
  inter_sets := by
    rintro s t ⟨K, F, hs⟩ ⟨L, G, ht⟩
    refine ⟨max K L, F ∪ G, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨hs ⟨(le_max_left _ _).trans hx.1, ?_⟩,
      ht ⟨(le_max_right _ _).trans hx.1, ?_⟩⟩
    · intro A hA
      exact hx.2 A (Finset.mem_union_left G hA)
    · intro A hA
      exact hx.2 A (Finset.mem_union_right F hA)

instance synchronizedFilter_neBot : NeBot synchronizedFilter := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_⟩
  have he : (∅ : Set RowDomain) ∈ synchronizedFilter := empty_mem_iff_bot.mpr h
  obtain ⟨K, F, hKF⟩ := he
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := synchronizedRows_nonempty K F
  exact hKF hx

theorem synchronizedRows_mem (K : ℕ) (F : Finset (Set ColumnDomain)) :
    synchronizedRows K F ∈ synchronizedFilter := ⟨K, F, Set.Subset.refl _⟩

theorem synchronizedFilter_level (K : ℕ) : {x : RowDomain | K ≤ x.1} ∈ synchronizedFilter :=
  mem_of_superset (synchronizedRows_mem K ∅) (fun _ hx => hx.1)

theorem synchronizedFilter_le_cofinite : synchronizedFilter ≤ cofinite := by
  intro s hs
  have hfin : sᶜ.Finite := hs
  let K := hfin.toFinset.sup Sigma.fst + 1
  apply mem_of_superset (synchronizedFilter_level K)
  intro x hx
  by_contra hxs
  have hb : x.1 ≤ hfin.toFinset.sup Sigma.fst :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := Sigma.fst) (hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hxs)
  dsimp [K] at hx
  omega

theorem synchronizedFilter_membership (A : Set ColumnDomain) (n m : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ x in synchronizedFilter, selector n x ∈ A ↔ selector m x ∈ A := by
  apply mem_of_superset (synchronizedRows_mem 0 {A})
  intro x hx
  exact hx.2 A (Finset.mem_singleton_self _) n m

theorem synchronizedFilter_disagreement {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≠ m) :
    ∀ᶠ x in synchronizedFilter, selector n x ≠ selector m x := by
  apply mem_of_superset (synchronizedFilter_level (max n m))
  intro x hx
  exact selector_distinct_of_le hnm x ((le_max_left _ _).trans hx)
    ((le_max_right _ _).trans hx)

/-- The row ultrafilter produced by the finite partition argument. -/
def synchronizedRowUltrafilter : Ultrafilter RowDomain := Ultrafilter.of synchronizedFilter

/-- Its common selector image. -/
def synchronizedColumnUltrafilter : Ultrafilter ColumnDomain :=
  Ultrafilter.map (selector 0) synchronizedRowUltrafilter

theorem synchronizedRowUltrafilter_le :
    (synchronizedRowUltrafilter : Filter RowDomain) ≤ synchronizedFilter :=
  Ultrafilter.of_le _

theorem synchronizedUltrafilters_spec :
    Synchronized synchronizedRowUltrafilter synchronizedColumnUltrafilter := by
  have hU := synchronizedRowUltrafilter_le
  have hcof := hU.trans synchronizedFilter_le_cofinite
  refine ⟨hcof, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change Filter.map (selector 0) (synchronizedRowUltrafilter : Filter RowDomain) ≤ cofinite
    exact (Filter.map_mono hcof).trans (selector_tendsto_cofinite 0)
  · intro n
    apply Ultrafilter.ext
    intro A
    simp only [synchronizedColumnUltrafilter, Ultrafilter.mem_map]
    exact Filter.eventually_congr (hU (synchronizedFilter_membership A n 0))
  · intro n m hnm
    exact Ultrafilter.compl_mem_iff_notMem.mp (hU (synchronizedFilter_disagreement hnm))

/-- Lemma 8.1: free ultrafilters with identical selector pushforwards and
pairwise distinct selectors almost everywhere. -/
theorem lemma_8_1_proof : Lemma_8_1 :=
  ⟨synchronizedRowUltrafilter, synchronizedColumnUltrafilter, synchronizedUltrafilters_spec⟩

end Posets
